name: yq

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: YAML processor for shell workflows and configuration parsing
installHint: Linux installs the pinned Mike Farah yq v4.53.2 release into ~/.vrooli/bin with SHA-256 verification; macOS and Windows fall back to the declared Homebrew and winget packages. apt's yq is a different tool and is intentionally not used.
notes: Linux release checksums were verified against the official v4.53.2 checksums asset.

linux.evidence: Manifest-declared applicability; no host-sampled qualification recorded.

macos.evidence: Manifest-declared applicability; no host-sampled qualification recorded.

windows.evidence: Manifest-declared applicability; no host-sampled qualification recorded.
